description: This file defines the CatalogItemViewModelService class, which implements the ICatalogItemViewModelService interface. It provides functionality to update catalog items using a repository pattern, including fetching an item by ID, guarding against null values, and updating item details.

classes.name: CatalogItemViewModelService
classes.description: Service class responsible for updating catalog items based on view models

methods.name: UpdateCatalogItem
methods.description: Updates an existing catalog item based on the provided view model, fetching it from the repository, performing null checks, and updating its details.
